description:
Subject: Overview of the **myorg/utilities** library package  

The **myorg/utilities** package is delivered as a library whose header files reside in the **include** directory and source files in **src**. It has been tested with both **gcc** (version ≥ 9.0) and **clang** (version ^12) and supports the **linux** and **windows** platforms on **x86**, **x64**, and **arm64** architectures. Users may link against it statically or dynamically. Runtime dependencies include **myorg/core** (version ^2.5, static linking required) and **myorg/logger** (version ~1.3). For development we rely on **myorg/testing** (version ^0.9, dynamic linking). Pre‑processor macros are defined per build mode: the debug configuration sets **ENABLE_LOGGING=1**, while the release configuration sets **OPTIMIZE=2**.  

Convenient scripts are provided: on Linux the **build:linux** script runs `make all`; the generic **clean** script executes `rm -rf build/` followed by `rm -f *.o`; and on Windows the **test:windows** script launches `run-tests.bat`. The package searches for additional components first in a local repository at **/opt/packages**, then in a remote Git repository at **https://github.com/myorg/custom-packages.git** before falling back to the official source.
